decisions.reason: Selecting eight catalog badges and excluding Legend does not change the existing milestone triggers, award destination, or function of the remaining badges.
The presentation consequence is already fully captured by the same-message MODIFY establishing a four-by-four grid; catalog attributes should remain owned by the source Requirement.
The FAQ state does not specify the badge catalog membership or count, so the catalog decision requires no FAQ change.
The mission page refers generically to badges and achievements; that copy remains valid after selecting eight badges and excluding Legend.
The approved badge catalog has no effect on the deferred Transak fiat-mint provider or payment behavior.
Badge catalog selection does not alter background wallet provisioning for fiat buyers.
The badge catalog decision does not change secondary-sale royalties, funding behavior, or the ERC-721C enforcement mechanism.
The number and membership of achievement badges do not alter the Small Block prize amount, trigger, winner count, or funding.
The referral-message wording change is an independent clause already captured by its own same-message MODIFY and is not a consequence of the badge catalog decision.
The client's approval of NFT size and the View Book button is independent runtime evidence; badge catalog membership does not change NFT asset presentation.
The badge catalog decision does not affect the USDC wallet mint flow or its expected outcome.
The approved badge count and removal of Legend do not affect Pinata, IPFS storage, or ebook removal behavior.
